purpose: A contained surface that groups related content and its actions: header, title, description, an optional corner action, content and footer.

notFor.case: Interrupting the flow for a decision.
A message about the page or the system.
Stacked sections the person opens and closes.
A card nested inside another card.

Default.visual: Surface/layer-1 fill, Border/subtle edge, xs shadow (shadow.xs); title and content Content/primary, description Content/secondary.

a11y.keyboard: Not focusable; its content brings its own controls.

openQuestions: Card is code-only, with no Figma set (finding DOC-001 Card). Should it get one?

The accessibility note says clickable cards use role="button" or a wrapping <a> with a visible focus ring, but the contract says Card is not focusable and has no hover or focus state. Are clickable cards supported?
